title: Chinese Book Reader module with library, editor, and Web Speech TTS

requirements.summary: Add React Query hooks for book/lesson + sentence list/detail + CRUD with proper cache invalidation.
acceptanceCriteria: New hooks exist for listing books/lessons, fetching a selected book/lesson, and mutating content.
Mutations invalidate/refetch the correct queries so the UI updates immediately after edits.
Hooks handle the ‘actor not available’ state consistently with existing hooks.

file_operations.description: Add Book Reader data hooks following existing patterns: useListBooks, useGetBook(bookId), and mutation hooks for create/update/delete book plus add/update/delete sentence; ensure query keys (e.g., ['books'], ['book', bookId]) and invalidation/refetch behavior keep library/reader/editor UI consistent; keep 'Actor not available' handling consistent with existing hooks. (Selected component: authorization — keep usage consistent with existing authenticated data access patterns; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.)

requirements.summary: Add Book Reader UI area with navigation + routes for library and reader pages.
acceptanceCriteria: A new navigation item is visible in the main layout and leads to the new book reader pages.
Users can see a list of available books/lessons and open one.
The reader view renders the Chinese sentences in the correct order and remains usable on mobile screens.

file_operations.description: Create a library/list page that uses the new hooks to display available books/lessons and allows selecting one to open in the reader; include responsive layout suitable for mobile. Use shadcn-ui components for cards/buttons/inputs/layout; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reader page that fetches the selected book/lesson by route param and renders its sentences in deterministic order (as provided by backend), optimized for mobile reading. Use shadcn-ui components for layout/controls; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Register new TanStack Router routes for the Book Reader area (library route and reader route) under the existing root route without removing or breaking existing pages (Members, Financial, Programs, Groups, Attendance). Wire routes so navigation works end-to-end.

Add a new navigation item in the main layout navItems for the Book Reader area, keeping existing navigation intact and ensuring mobile menu behavior remains correct. Use existing shadcn-ui Button/Sheet composition; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Implement per-sentence in-browser Chinese text-to-speech with Play/Stop, autoplay next, and rate/pitch controls using Web Speech API.
acceptanceCriteria: Each sentence row has a Play control that reads the Chinese text aloud.
When Autoplay is enabled, finishing one sentence automatically starts the next sentence.
Speech uses a Chinese language tag (e.g., 'zh-CN') and the UI offers rate and pitch controls that affect playback.
If speechSynthesis is unavailable, the UI shows a clear fallback message and does not crash.

file_operations.description: Create a dedicated hook wrapping the Web Speech API (speechSynthesis) to manage speaking state, cancellation, per-utterance configuration (lang 'zh-CN', rate, pitch), and an autoplay-next mechanism that can trigger playback of the next sentence upon onend.

Create a reusable per-sentence control UI (Play/Stop + autoplay toggle + rate/pitch controls) using the useSpeechSynthesis hook, with a clear fallback message if speechSynthesis is unavailable. Use shadcn-ui components for buttons/switch/slider/form controls; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Wire SentenceTtsControls into each sentence row in the reader page, ensuring Play/Stop works per sentence, autoplay-next advances in the displayed order, and rate/pitch settings affect playback. Ensure graceful fallback UI when the Web Speech API is not available.

requirements.summary: Add a content editor UI to create/edit books and add/edit/delete/reorder sentences using backend CRUD methods.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can create a new book/lesson with a title.
Users can add, edit, delete, and reorder sentences for a book/lesson.
Changes persist after refresh and are visible in the library and reader views.
Editor provides basic validation (non-empty title; non-empty Chinese sentence).

file_operations.description: Create an editor page that uses the book and sentence mutation hooks to create/update/delete books and add/update/delete sentences, including sentence reordering (by persisting updated sentence order via existing backend mutation capabilities). Provide basic validation for required fields (non-empty title and non-empty Chinese sentence). Use shadcn-ui components for forms/dialogs/tables/buttons; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add entry points from the library page to create a new book and to open the editor for an existing book, ensuring the UI uses backend-backed CRUD (no hardcoded seed-only content). Use shadcn-ui dialogs/buttons for create flows; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add routing for the editor UI (e.g., a nested route under the Book Reader area) and ensure it is reachable from the library/reader without breaking existing routes.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive reading-app visual theme to the new Book Reader pages while fitting existing Tailwind/shadcn styling.
acceptanceCriteria: Book Reader pages have a consistent, readable visual style (spacing, typography, colors) suitable for long text reading.
UI remains accessible (readable contrast, clear focus states) and responsive on mobile and desktop.

file_operations.description: Add theme support classes/utilities (using Tailwind layers) to provide a warm paper-like background, high-contrast typography, and subtle ink accents specifically for Book Reader pages, while staying consistent with the existing CSS variables and shadcn/Tailwind design system.

Apply the reading-app theme styles (paper-like background/typography spacing) to the library UI in a consistent and accessible way; ensure responsiveness on mobile/desktop. Use shadcn-ui layout primitives where appropriate; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Apply the reading-app theme styles to the reader UI, ensuring sentence rows remain readable, controls have clear focus states, and the view works well on mobile screens. Use shadcn-ui components for consistent styling; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Apply the same theme styling to the editor to keep the Book Reader area visually cohesive while maintaining form readability and accessibility. Use shadcn-ui components; Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add and render required generated static image assets for the Book Reader module from frontend/public/assets/generated.
acceptanceCriteria: The new generated image(s) exist under frontend/public/assets/generated and are referenced directly by the new UI.
Assets load correctly in the web build without backend involvement.

file_operations.description: Add the generated static Book Reader cover image asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/book-cover.dim_1200x1600.png.

Reference and render the generated cover image from frontend/public/assets/generated/book-cover.dim_1200x1600.png in the Book Reader library UI (e.g., module header/hero section) so it is included and visible without any backend involvement.

Optionally reference frontend/public/assets/generated/book-cover.dim_1200x1600.png in the hidden asset preloader component to help ensure the asset is included across builds. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
